_doc: Curated, structured road-sign section rules for the exam simulator, transcribed from each state's verified knowledgeTest.roadSigns text (research/facts/XX.json). Merged into app state files by app/scripts/import-state-facts.mjs. questions/passingScore here describe the WHOLE simulated exam.

NY.source: NY Driver's Manual p.10: 20 questions, 14 correct, including at least 2 of 4 road-sign questions

IL.source: IL Rules of the Road Review Workbook: 15 sign-identification + 20 multiple-choice/true-false questions

GA.source: GA DDS: Road Signs test 20 questions (15 needed) and Road Rules test 20 questions (15 needed), scored separately

NC.source: NCDMV: knowledge test (40 questions, 32 needed) plus a separate traffic-sign test (identify 9 of 12)

VA.source: Virginia DMV Knowledge Exam page + Driver's Manual p.5: part 1 = 10 road-sign questions, all 10 must be correct; part 2 = 30 general knowledge questions, 24 correct

WI.source: Wisconsin Motorists' Handbook (2026) p.5: separate Highway Signs Test (15 questions, 12 correct) and Knowledge Test (50 questions, 40 correct)
